name: litigation-system
description: Litigation management system for Sarie Eldin & Partners

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U litigation -d litigation
scripts.db:verify: docker compose exec db psql -U litigation -d litigation -f /verify.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
